; RAPPS-format entry used to prove the RAPPS-S-dialog-hang fix: its URLDownload is an
; unreachable (.invalid) host, so "rapps /install /S fmnohang" must FAIL PROMPTLY with a
; non-zero exit code and NO modal dialog (which, headless, would block the featmgr child
; up to the 60-min watchdog). Imported by featmgr /import-rapps into rapps-fmnohang.
;
; RAPPS drops the generic [Section] URLDownload on non-x86 and reads the arch-specific
; one, so the download URL is given per arch: [Section] serves i386, [Section.amd64]/
; [Section.arm64] serve 64-bit. All point at the same unreachable host.
[Section]
Name = FmNoHang Test
Version = 1.0.0
Category = 13
URLDownload = https://nohang.invalid/fmnohang-1.0.0.exe
SHA1 = 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000
SizeBytes = 1024

[Section.amd64]
URLDownload = https://nohang.invalid/fmnohang-1.0.0-amd64.exe
SHA1 = 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000
SizeBytes = 1024

[Section.arm64]
URLDownload = https://nohang.invalid/fmnohang-1.0.0-arm64.exe
SHA1 = 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000
SizeBytes = 1024
